In [[Flames of the Bear Spirit]] [[Egil Fireteller]] will show one how to summon the [[Bear Spirit]] from the [[Sacred Altar]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Travel to the [[Sacred Altar|sacred altar]] and light the spiritual flame to summon the bear spirit.
* Prevent the [[Arctic Nightmare|arctic nightmares]] from consuming the spiritual flame.
* See [[Egil Fireteller]] for your reward.

===Reward===
*2,000 [[Experience]]
*250 [[Norn reputation point]]s

== Walkthrough ==
Lead Egil Fireteller and your party through [[Jaga Moraine]] to the Bear Spirit's altar. Fight off the invading Arctic Nightmares, and try to interrupt their [[Consume Flames]] skill. When all the invading waves are killed, Bear Spirit appears and Egil Fireteller gives you the reward. Fire damage is useful against most of the foes going to the sacred altar.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Egil Fireteller
:''It's good to see that Jora can once again become the bear. Now, mayhaps, {{sic}} she may regain her status. There is but one obstacle, one mountain she must yet climb. Her [[Jora's homestead|clan homestead]] is overrun with Charr. No respected Norn would allow the land to be violated by such beasts. If you help Jora reclaim her lands, only then will she be able to help you. You will all need the strength of Bear herself to defeat the Charr. We must first commune with the '''bear spirit''' and seek counsel. Let us journey to the '''sacred altar''' south of here. We will light the spiritual flame. Bear will come if our cause is true.''
{{offer dialog
| accept = I will be glad to aid Jora.
| decline = Perhaps later.
| ask = We must light the '''spiritual flame''' and seek Bear's blessing.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
Initial
:'''Egil Fireteller''': ''The bear spirit is the strength of the mountains. The Norn owe Bear more than just our prowess in battle....''
:'''Egil Fireteller''': ''We owe our homes and lives to Bear. You must show your strength of spirit by protecting the sacred flame.

===Reward dialogue===
;Egil Fireteller
:''You know what must be done. Jora's lands must be purged of the Charr. Their kind do not respect the spirit of the land. We must journey up the mountain to the Shrine of the Bear Spirit. It is there that Bear shall grant you the power you need to repel the Charr. Once you are ready, let us journey into Bjora Marches.''

==Notes==
* Upon accepting the quest reward, you also accept the quest [[Blood Washes Blood]].
* If you leave the map after completing only the first part of this quest (capturing the altar), you will have to re-capture the altar by standing near it. If this doesn't work, you may have to abandon and redo the quest. 
* [[Arctic Nightmare]]s do not drop loot, yield experience, or count for [[Norn Hunting Party]]; ANet has confirmed this to be intentional.
* The nightmares at the altar do not cease to spawn, which can be problematic for parties lacking enough means to deal with them. In this case (if party protection and healing permits)  a player can disable all damage skills equipped on healers, set all heroes to Avoid Combat and flag the party near [[Jarnskeggi]]. From there, pull the six spawn [[Arctic Nightmare]]s into the team area. While the team resists the [[Arctic Nightmare]]s attacks, a player should have enough time to move to the altar, with [[Egil Fireteller]] following them, and capture it successfully.
